title: corpus/held-out/<plan>.json
description: The held-out partition's own interaction plan steps and oracles (Story 1.51, AD-9, AD-22), which evaluation.json's partitionPlan.heldOutPlan names. The held-out and both views append interactionPlan and oracles to contract.json's and add behaviorOracles to each named behavior; a development run never opens this file. Each step and oracle has the shape eval-quality's contract gives it, and the engine's compile over the held-out view is what judges them; tea-evaluate check validates each against the contract schema in the view and names a path or an ID, never a value. The tea-evaluate runtime owns this schema.

interactionPlan.description: Steps only the held-out partition runs, appended after the shared steps. A step's stepId must differ from every stepId of contract.json, and its after clause may name a shared or a held-out step only.

oracles.description: Oracles over the held-out steps (or shared ones). Each leaves no trace in the development partition. An oracle's ID must differ from every oracle ID of contract.json.

behaviorOracles.description: The oracle IDs each behavior gains in the held-out view, keyed by behaviorId. Every behavior keeps at least one oracle there, because the engine compiles each behavior against the oracles it names; a behavior whose only oracle reads a development-only step needs an entry here.
